description: Two descriptors with disjoint flag sets: a 4 GiB+32 byte file with size/attributes/write-time/progress, and a directory with clsid/sizepoint/linkui and a junk file size whose FD_FILESIZE is clear
notes: Hand-built to the FILEDESCRIPTORW layout in MS docs; 592 bytes each, cItems first. The second name is non-ASCII, and its nFileSize halves hold 0xDEADBEEF with FD_FILESIZE clear so that a parser which ignores dwFlags is caught.
